defects.defectStep: V21 step 39 'Derived Pricing Formula' (tier lookup on Maintenance Type Defn AttributeValue; missing MTD attribute -> tier=0 -> NetUnitPrice=0; no safe-default tier for missing MTD)
defects.expected: All New Maintenance products should carry Maintenance Type Defn (MTD) attribute so V21 step 39 'Derived Pricing Formula' resolves a tier (e.g. Standard=0.20) and produces NetUnitPrice = 0.20 x Source_List_Price. BoKS: PIAMBK -> MTD=Standard -> NetUnitPrice=71 (355x0.20). FIM CCM family: MTD present on products -> tier lookup -> NetUnitPrice > 0.
defects.actual: BoKS PASSES: QLI 0QLWC000003kUpO4AU NetUnitPrice=71, Source_List_Price=355 (20% confirmed). FIM FAILS: All FIM CCM New Maintenance lines net $0/null after fresh V21 Force-reprice (isSuccess:true). CCMMSN (0QLWC000003g4QT4AY): NetUnitPrice=0, Source_List_Price=34750; CCMLSE lines (0QLWC000003g4YX4AY/g4YZ4AY/g4Ya4AI): NetUnitPrice=0/0/null, Source_List_Price=2008 each. defects.defectStep: ManualQuoteLevelAmountBasedLineLevel (BKM actionType=ManualDiscount, InputUnitPrice=NetUnitPrice, AdjustmentValue=ItemDiscountAmount), fed by SyncInputUnitPriceforDiscountBase/SyncInputUnitPricefromNet (top-level seq=13: InputUnitPrice <- NetUnitPrice). Root cause = no NetUnitPrice->ListPrice re-seed for a direct OneTime line before discounting: 'OneTime Net Seed' (seq19) = IF(NetUnitPrice>0,NetUnitPrice,InputUnitPrice) preserves the prior net, and 'Reset Net to Pre-Partner Base' (seq14) only resets to ListPrice when PartnerDiscountPercent>0 (false for this direct line).
defects.regression: Run2 PASS was a first-reprice artifact: at insert time, platform seeds NetUnitPrice=50000 (from UnitPrice), so InputUnitPrice was synced to 50000 and the first reprice correctly produced 45000. On the second reprice (run3), NetUnitPrice was already 45000, InputUnitPrice synced to 45000, and the amount step produced 40000. The defect in SyncInputUnitPriceforDiscountBase predates run2 and would be hit by any real sales rep re-editing and re-pricing a quote with an amount discount.
defects.expected: NetUnitPrice = 50000 - 5000 = 45000; NetTotalPrice = 45000 * 2 = 90000; TotalPrice = 90000; ListPrice/UnitPrice = 50000. Discount applies once off list price, idempotent on repeated reprice.
defects.actual: After Force-reprice (isSuccess=true) on 2026-06-30: NetUnitPrice=40000, NetTotalPrice=80000, TotalPrice=80000, TotalAdjustmentAmount=-20000. Source_List_Price__c=45000, Pre_Partner_Price__c=45000, Base_Price__c=45000. The $5000 amount discount was applied to the already-discounted 45000 (from run2) rather than the list price 50000, producing an additional $5000 deduction (double-discount on re-reprice).
